{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values for baseline
valid_data = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check if arm and severity are balanced across groups
print("\nArm vs Severity cross-tab:")
print(pd.crosstab(valid_data['arm'], valid_data['severity']))

print("\nArm vs Site cross-tab:")
print(pd.crosstab(valid_data['arm'], valid_data['site']))

# Check if the treatment group has a higher response rate
response_by_arm = valid_data.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
print(response_by_arm)

# Check the mean change in biomarker
valid_data['biomarker_change'] = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']
mean_change_by_arm = valid_data.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()
print("\nMean biomarker change by arm:")
print(mean_change_by_arm)"}
